title: This Might Be the Best Carbonara Recipe on YouTube

segments.description: Wide establishing shot of a sunlit Italian kitchen counter displaying fresh pasta, eggs, Pecorino Romano cheese, and cured guanciale [[00:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M94peyp_3UE&t=2)].
Medium close-up shot of the chef slicing cured guanciale into thick, uniform strips on a wooden cutting board [[01:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M94peyp_3UE&t=70)].
Close-up action shot of the guanciale sizzling and rendering its rich fat in a cold stainless steel pan over medium heat [[02:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M94peyp_3UE&t=155)].
Medium shot of fresh organic egg yolks being separated from the egg whites into a large ceramic mixing bowl [[04:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M94peyp_3UE&t=240)].
Close-up shot of finely grated Pecorino Romano cheese being whisked vigorously into the rich egg yolks with cracked black pepper [[05:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M94peyp_3UE&t=330)].
Medium action shot of artisanal rigatoni pasta boiling in a large pot of salted water until perfectly al dente [[07:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M94peyp_3UE&t=420)].
Close-up action shot of starchy pasta water being ladled into the rendered guanciale fat to create a glossy emulsion [[08:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M94peyp_3UE&t=495)].
Medium action shot of the pasta being tossed off-heat with the egg-cheese mixture and rendered fat until a silky, creamy sauce forms [[09:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M94peyp_3UE&t=585)].
Wide tabletop shot displaying the finished traditional Roman carbonara garnished with crispy guanciale and extra pecorino [[10:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M94peyp_3UE&t=650)].
